packages.name: FTP
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Starts an FTP server on the device. Run again to stop it. Automatically times out after 5 minutes of inactivity. Optionally modify the script to set a root password.

packages.name: FTP Enable
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Enables FTP at every boot by mounting /mnt/SDCARD. Run once to enable persistent FTP access (user: root, pass: root). Run again to disable the boot entry.

packages.name: Telnetd
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Installs a static telnetd binary and adds it to rc.local so the device is accessible via Telnet on port 23 at every boot. Sets root credentials to user: root, pass: root. Only needs to be run once.

packages.name: Random Game
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Picks a random emulator and a matching ROM from your SDCARD and launches it. Configurable base directories for Roms and Emus via script edit.

packages.name: Max CPU
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Forces the device into Performance CPU governor mode and keeps it there even after resets or FN button presses. LEDs turn green on success.

packages.name: Reboot
packages.author: djware
packages.description: A simple app to restart the TrimUI Smart Pro quickly and cleanly from within the menu.

packages.name: Mac Update
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Sets the device Wi-Fi MAC address to a static value to prevent connectivity issues across reboots. Not required on firmware 1.0.4 hotfix 20240414 or later.

packages.name: RainbowLEDs
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Cycles the joystick and middle LEDs through a full rainbow of colors in a continuous loop. Run the app again to stop the effect.

packages.name: LED Temp
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Colors the LEDs to indicate CPU temperature in real time: green (<40C) through red (>70C). Run the app again to stop the effect.

packages.name: LED Batt
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Colors the LEDs to indicate remaining battery percentage in real time: green (100-90%) through red (<20%). Run the app again to stop the effect.

packages.name: UDISK
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Formats and unlocks the internal UDISK partition as FAT32, exposing ~6 GB of on-device storage for apps, emulators, and ROMs. Also replaces the stock usb_storage app to allow simultaneous SDCARD and UDISK USB mounting. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK — formats UDISK partition. Only needs to be run once.

packages.name: Bootlogo Updater
packages.author: djware
packages.description: Replaces the startup boot image with a custom BMP file. Place a logo.bmp (max 1280x720, under 6 MB) on the root of SDCARD or UDISK and run this app to apply it.

packages.name: EmuCleaner
packages.author: schmurtzm
packages.description: Automatically hides emulators that have no ROMs installed and re-enables those that do. Prevents a cluttered console list and is also useful after adding new ROMs to refresh which emulators are visible. Edits Emus/show.json using the same mechanism as the stock MainUI, so manual show/hide overrides still work.

packages.name: BootLogo
packages.author: schmurtzm
packages.description: A user-friendly app for flashing a custom boot logo on the TrimUI Smart Pro. Place your image on the SD card and run the app to apply it at startup.

packages.name: System Tools
packages.author: schmurtzm
packages.description: A hub app that centralizes multiple utility scripts and tools in one place, including a PSX Analog Detector that auto-configures controller settings for PlayStation games compatible with analog sticks.

packages.name: Resume at Boot
packages.author: schmurtzm
packages.description: A set of scripts that adds a resume-last-game feature on startup, automatically relaunching the most recently played game when the device powers on.

packages.name: Scraper
packages.author: schmurtzm
packages.description: A command-line ScreenScraper implementation that automatically downloads box art and media for your ROM library directly on the device.

packages.name: Backup Config Files
packages.author: SneakyTwitch
packages.description: Backs up emulator configuration files for PPSSPP, NDS (DraStic), and RetroArch — including button mappings, core configs, and shader settings — to a timestamped archive on the SDCARD. Run before any major system change to protect your settings.

packages.name: Restore Config Files
packages.author: SneakyTwitch
packages.description: Restores a previously created configuration backup for PPSSPP, NDS (DraStic), and RetroArch. Reads the latest backup version from ForRestoring.txt in the backup folder, or restore a specific version by editing that file. Requires a prior backup to exist.

packages.name: BGM Start/Stop
packages.author: SneakyTwitch
packages.description: Toggles background music on or off for the currently active theme. If the theme folder has a bgm.mp3 in its sound directory, this app will start or stop it. Per-theme state is remembered between runs.

packages.name: BGM Swap
packages.author: SneakyTwitch
packages.description: Replaces the current theme's background music with a custom bgm.mp3 placed in the root of the SDCARD. Updates the BGM for whichever theme is currently active. The original BGM is backed up on first run as bgm-bak.mp3.

packages.name: CollaGen
packages.author: rkr87
packages.description: CLI-based game collection generator for the TrimUI Smart Pro. Dynamically creates and refreshes ROM collections using keyword include/exclude filters. Compatible with CrossMix-OS and, with minor edits, Stock OS. Copy the CollaGen folder to /Apps, launch it, and use the on-screen terminal to build named collections.

packages.name: OctoLair
packages.author: Primitheus
packages.description: Downloads ROMs directly onto the TrimUI Smart Pro from within the device, with a controller-friendly SDL2 UI. Browse systems and game listings, select titles, and download them straight to the appropriate ROM folder without touching a PC.

packages.name: EmuDrop
packages.author: ahmadteeb
packages.description: Feature-rich ROM downloader with built-in screen scraper for TrimUI Smart Pro and TrimUI Brick. Provides a sleek SDL2 controller-friendly interface to browse platforms and game libraries, search, download ROMs, and pull cover art from multiple sources. Compatible with Stock OS, CrossMix-OS, and Knulli.

packages.name: DNS Changer
packages.author: ahmadteeb
packages.description: Changes the DNS server settings on the TrimUI Smart Pro and TrimUI Brick. Useful for improving connectivity, bypassing region restrictions, or using custom DNS resolvers. Built with Python and SDL2 for a controller-friendly on-device UI.

packages.name: ThemixPro
packages.author: veckia9x
packages.description: Automatically updates system icons, selected-state icons, and background images whenever a theme is changed. Themes must include icon, iconsel, and background subfolders with files named after each emulator system (e.g. SFC.png). Ships with the GREYS-DARK theme by tenlevels. Requires TRIMUI_EX or TomatoOS.

packages.name: Syncthing
packages.author: veckia9x
packages.description: Installs and runs Syncthing on the TrimUI Smart Pro for wireless file synchronization between the device and a PC or phone. Optionally enables Syncthing on boot. Default credentials: user trimui / pass trimuisync. Requires TRIMUI_EX or TomatoOS.

packages.name: BrickTools
packages.author: hugorosario
packages.description: Collection of tools and system apps for the TrimUI Brick, built to match the stock theme's assets and fonts. Menus for utilities, network, user interface, LED control and system settings, and you can add your own entries in menu.json. Works with stock firmware and StockMix/CrossMix. Extract the release zip to the root of the SD card.

packages.name: Grout
packages.author: rommapp
packages.description: RomM client for retro handhelds. Connects to your RomM server over Wi-Fi so you can browse your library and download games straight to the device. Install on TrimUI stock OS by copying the Grout folder from the Grout-Trimui release zip into Apps. Tested on the TrimUI Brick and Smart Pro.

packages.name: Trimui-XiaoZhi
packages.author: nlkcodenew
packages.description: Unofficial Xiaozhi voice assistant for the TrimUI Smart Pro S on stock OS (the repository also lists Brick Pro). Press A to talk and B to stop; includes chat history, a settings menu, device activation and an optional web chat interface. Checks for updates on launch (can be disabled with XIAOZHI_NO_OTA=1).

packages.name: Trimui Terminal
packages.author: nlkcodenew
packages.description: SDL2 terminal (a fork of SimpleTerminal) for the TrimUI Brick Pro and Smart Pro S, with a built-in bt-survey tool that checks whether the device could act as a Bluetooth gamepad for iPad, iPhone or Android. Brick Pro on stock OS is the primary target; the Smart Pro S uses the same binary but is not fully tested. Checks for updates on launch.

packages.name: Music Player
packages.author: nlkcodenew
packages.description: Self-contained music player for the TrimUI Brick Pro on stock OS. Scans the SD card for WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC and OPUS, and can browse and save tracks from shared Google Drive folders. Custom playlists, synced LRC lyrics, sleep timer, three-band equalizer, USB DAC and Bluetooth support. Bundles its own runtime and updates itself over verified TLS.

packages.name: LED Control
packages.author: ro8inmorgan
packages.description: Controls the LEDs on the TrimUI Brick: L and R switch between lights, D-pad up/down picks a setting, left/right changes its value. Quit with B rather than the power button so the background LED process stops cleanly. Works on stock OS, StockMix/CrossMix and MinUI; includes LCRemove.pak to uninstall.

packages.name: Brick LED Controller
packages.author: pierceTee
packages.description: Configures the LEDs on the TrimUI Brick: brightness, color and effects, syncing LED colors, extended RGB colors, and the low-battery warning. Includes an uninstall option that removes its services and system files. Works on stock OS and MinUI.

packages.name: Trimui Remote
packages.author: nlkcodenew
packages.description: SSH access (dropbear) for the TrimUI Brick Pro and Smart Pro S on stock OS, for debugging and file transfer from a PC over Wi-Fi.
